questions.rationale: Network continuity matters when cooperative state can be interrupted.
conditions: Apply when a cooperative session uses networked state.
verificationPrompts: What happens when a participant leaves or reconnects?

questions.rationale: Coordination is relevant when players share goals or resources.
conditions: Apply when the reference supports cooperative play.
verificationPrompts: How are roles, communication, and shared outcomes coordinated?

questions.rationale: Match rules and queues are relevant when players compete directly.
conditions: Apply when competitive player-versus-player play is present.
verificationPrompts: What determines match entry, objectives, and completion?

questions.rationale: Reporting and safety paths need review when strangers interact competitively.
conditions: Apply when social interaction between competitors is observable.
verificationPrompts: What reporting, mute, block, or moderation paths are exposed?

questions.rationale: Session continuity remains a check even when multiplayer is absent.
conditions: Apply when the reference has saves, cloud state, or online checks.
verificationPrompts: What play, save, and recovery behavior is available without a party?
